question.text: The equation of the planes parallel to the plane <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>z</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> which are at unit distance from the point <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>2</mn><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>a</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi><mi>z</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo></math> If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mi>b</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>d</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>K</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>c</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>,</mo></math> then the positive value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>K</mi></math> is

solution.text:
Let plane parallel to given plane is x-2y+2z+λ=0

Distance from 1, 2, 3=1

⇒|λ+3|5=1⇒λ=0,-6

On comparing with given equation

⇒a=1,b=-2,c=2,d=-6 or 0

b-d=4 or -2, c-a=1

⇒K=4 or -2
